analysis.summary: The PR removes the JFrog registry configuration but fails to provide the Aliyun replacement specified in the title, leading to an incomplete migration.

bugs.title: Missing Aliyun registry configuration
bugs.description: The .npmrc file containing the @smart scoped registry configuration was deleted, but no replacement for the Aliyun registry (as indicated by the PR title) was added to the repository.
bugs.risk: This is an incomplete update that will cause high-severity functional failures. Specifically, package managers (npm/pnpm/yarn) will fail to resolve or authenticate packages under the @smart scope during installation, breaking the build and deployment pipeline.
